boundaries.publicDtoRule: Public DTOs are explicit field allowlists and never serialize Base44 IDs, internal primary keys, secrets, raw contact data, unrestricted object URLs, or unmasked registration values.

Aircraft.meaning: Durable real-world aircraft identity assembled from versioned source assertions; one aircraft may have zero or many listings.
Aircraft.deletion: tombstone identity, preserve non-personal provenance and never reuse ID

AircraftListing.meaning: Time-bounded offer to market an Aircraft; required aircraft_id points to canonical Aircraft.
AircraftListing.deletion: withdraw then tombstone; never delete or recycle ID because Aircraft persists

AircraftListing.authentication: anonymous read only for active public listings; owner/admin private operations use a separate authenticated DTO

redaction.registration: null or policy-approved mask for anonymous callers; never raw by default

ATICard.authentication: anonymous lookup only by public_card_code when status is active and not expired; subject, delegated broker, or admin authorization is required for any private-card DTO

redaction.aircraft_label: must be generated without registration or owner identity

publicIdentityLifecycle.generation: server-side cryptographically random 96-bit lowercase hex payload; atomic insert under a database uniqueness constraint with bounded collision retry
publicIdentityLifecycle.immutability: public IDs are immutable after assignment
publicIdentityLifecycle.uniqueness: prefix/type validation plus database unique constraints; collision retry occurs in the same authorized create operation
publicIdentityLifecycle.aliasAuthorization: merge/split alias changes require privileged role, reason, two-person approval for high-risk merges, transactional cycle/type checks and append-only audit evidence
publicIdentityLifecycle.merge: losing ac_ IDs become permanent aliases to surviving ac_ ID; listing IDs never alias to aircraft IDs; dependent rows are re-pointed atomically after authorization
publicIdentityLifecycle.split: issue new ac_ identity and retain versioned correction/alias history; historical listings move only through an authorized audited decision
publicIdentityLifecycle.deletion: return gone/not-public as policy requires while retaining non-sensitive tombstone and alias reservation
publicIdentityLifecycle.exposure: DTO only; internal SQL UUIDs and Base44 IDs remain private

apiKeys.generation: minimum 256 random bits, shown exactly once over an authenticated channel
apiKeys.storage: hash only plus non-secret display prefix; plaintext fields such as DeveloperAccount.api_key must not be migrated
apiKeys.rotation: new key and overlap window are explicit; old key is revoked; expiry/status checked on every request
apiKeys.recovery: no recovery of plaintext; replace by rotation
apiKeys.audit: creation, scope change, rotation, revocation and failed use are audited without key material

prohibited: raw query text that may contain PII
apiRequestLogs.redaction: owner_email and api_key_id are replaced with stable scoped pseudonyms; configurable query/body scrub happens before persistence

paymentAndKycBoundary.pciBoundary: Card entry and storage remain entirely with the PCI payment provider; ABOS receives tokens/references only.
paymentAndKycBoundary.kycAmlBoundary: Escrow/custody provider is authoritative for KYC/AML evidence and decisions; ABOS stores only provider reference and coarse status unless Legal approves otherwise.
paymentAndKycBoundary.webhooks: verify provider signature, reject replay, redact payload before logging

dataGovernance.legalHold: A scoped legal hold overrides purge but not least privilege; record authority, scope, start/end and release.
dataGovernance.objectStorage: Apply deny-by-default bucket/object policy, short-lived signed access, malware/content checks, version-aware deletion and audit.
dataGovernance.deletionPropagation: Approved deletion/anonymization propagates to database replicas, search indexes, caches, analytics event stores and object versions.
dataGovernance.backups: Backups are access-restricted, encrypted and expire on schedule; they are not surgically rewritten. A restore must replay tombstones and a re-erasure queue before serving traffic.
dataGovernance.scheduleApproval: All stated retention periods are proposals pending Privacy, Security, Legal, domain-owner and jurisdiction approval.

overlapReport.method: Top-level declared source fields and record semantics were compared. Similar names or a foreign-key relationship are not duplicate evidence.

evidence.fieldSetRelation: exact match in supplied source schemas

confirmedDuplicates.disposition: merge to scraper_runs after row-count/checksum reconciliation; freeze the losing writer and preserve source provenance

rejectedMergeCandidates.distinction: DealerLead is an FAA dealer-certificate prospect with cert_num, certification dates and ownership_type; Lead is a CRM person/contact lifecycle. Preserve separately or link explicitly.
EditorProfile is listing-scoped delegated editing authority with expiry, grantor and permission/audit fields; User is account identity and entitlement. It must reference User, not merge into it.
SalesFunnel stores configurable graph blocks/connections and conversion metrics; SalesPipeline stores an aircraft deal workflow anchored to a passport. Treat funnel as analytics/configuration.
TrafficAppearance is an individual time/position observation; TrafficSnapshot is a regional capture/cache parent. This is one-to-many, not duplication.
GlobalRegistry is multi-jurisdiction source data with country_code, source and raw_data; FAAAircraft is a US FAA snapshot. Both feed canonical Aircraft through source adapters.
UserProfile contains display, bio, permissions and security/profile metadata; keep as a one-to-one profile extension unless an approved identity ADR consolidates it.
AppConfig currently represents the ABOS-data-influence freeze while AdminSettings is a general section/value admin registry. Consolidation requires configuration ownership and typing decision.
